business_summary: Ningbo Sanxing Medical Electric Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells power distribution in China and internationally. The company offers prepaid. ANSI, classical, photovoltaic, and smart meters; data concentrator units, CIUS, and modules; and DC and AC chargers. It also provides AMI and smart prepayment solutions under the SanPlat name; Wi-SUN solution comprising smart meters, communication modules, gateways, repeaters, and network management systems; and FDM solutions. In addition, the company offers charging station and dynamic load balance solutions. Further, it provides financial leasing and consulting services, as well as medical services. The company was formerly known as Ningbo Sanxing Electric Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ningbo Sanxing Medical Electric Co.,Ltd. in October 2015. Ningbo Sanxing Medical Electric Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1986 and is based in Ningbo, China.
